tasks.instruction: Fusion must only synthesize complete OpenAI-compatible adviser answers. Accept the first choice only when its finish_reason is explicitly stop and it contains usable text with no refusal, provider error or tool/function-call request. Missing, null, unknown, truncated and filtered completion states must contribute no advice. Preserve successful text and text-part answers, including null optional metadata and empty tool-call arrays. Fully consume completed HTTP response bodies so rejected draft contents do not erase their actual usage accounting. Preserve concurrent collection, model order, existing byte/time limits, late-response cleanup, and fallback to remaining advisers or aggregator-only execution; never retry a rejected draft.
